metadata.question_title: SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY — First law of thermodynamics

question.stem: A gas receives 500 J of heat and does 200 J of work. Use \(\Delta U=Q-W\) to find the change in internal energy. Symbols: Δ, θ, μ, Ω, °.

answer_scheme.final_answer: The increase in internal energy is 300 J.

marking_steps.description: Select the first law with work done by the gas positive.

marking_steps.calculation: Substitute the given heat and work without changing their units.

student_hints.hint: Subtract work done by the gas from heat supplied.
